headline: PLAYOFF WEEK 1: AR Drops a 200-Burger and Tay-Tay's Baddies Get Heartbroken by 3
subhead: Two teams cleared 197 points in the same matchup and one of them still went home — meanwhile MassiveCocks brought a knife to a gunfight and forgot the knife.
matchOfTheWeek: Put an AR to My Head 200.74, T swift's Baddies 197.64. Davante Adams hung a 42.8 and Lamar dropped 36 and Tnicolle still lost — because leaving DeVonta Smith (28) AND Jalen Coker (21) on the bench in a 3-point loss is the kind of lineup decision that gets statues built of Jared Goff (41.06) in your honor. Kyle Dech survived a 200-point shootout by the width of a Jalen McMillan target share. Brutal cinema.
powerRankingsShakeup: AR is now the scariest team alive heading into the semis with a 200-spot, while OnlyFants got curb-stomped by 32 and is officially booking tee times. T swift's Baddies somehow drop despite scoring the second-most points in the league — playoff math is a cruel god.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the corpse. MassiveCocks scored 92.40. NINETY-TWO. In Week 15. With Drake Maye and his 18.48 rotting on the bench. You left 56.74 points on your pine, my guy — that's not a lineup, that's a hostage situation. Optimal was 149, you scored 92, and somewhere @7BigPapi7 is still trying to figure out which flex slot Drake Maye goes in. Mercifully, you weren't even in the playoffs to ruin them.

Over in the actual carnage, Stroud Boys took OnlyFants behind the woodshed 145-112. Aaron Rodgers dusted off the ayahuasca and posted 30 — Cubby, you ran into a buzzsaw and got 32-point dumpstered in round one. Pack the darkness retreat, season's over.

226 Alpha put up 155 on The Good Ladds despite Josh Allen going full Konami code for 41.28. Mig, your QB outscored entire rosters and you still lost by 23 — that's a special kind of pain. James Conner reminding everyone he exists with 30.8 was the dagger.

The Olave Garden quietly handled Jets' Juniors 152-137. Mike Evans dropped 36.9 for Wunder and it didn't matter because Patrick had the kind of balanced beatdown that doesn't need a hero. Jets' Juniors: thanks for playing, see you in the consolation bracket where dreams go to die.

And then the main event. AR vs Baddies, 398 combined points, decided by a field goal. Goff 41, ARSB 37, Brian Thomas 32 — Kyle's lineup was a cheat code. Tnicolle countered with Davante's 42.8 and Lamar's 36 and STILL benched 49 points of WR production. You don't lose that game by 3 — you lose it on Sunday morning when you set the lineup. Davante Adams in a Rams jersey is the most cursed thing I've typed all year.
